title: Physical camera motion
when_to_use: Use when a Seedance video task requires physical camera motion; this candidate is for explicit inspection only.
method: Specify subject motion and camera motion as independent physical trajectories. Declare initial camera position, lens/height if known, path, speed, orientation, and stopping position. Name focus target and scene-relative parallax; describe occlusion and continuity.
verification: Candidate; no real Seedance output validation. Do not auto-activate.
